cards.example_en: Nurses assist the doctor during the busy morning clinic.
cards.example_zh: 在忙碌的上午门诊里，护士协助医生。

cards.example_en: The assistant coach timed every lap on the running track.
cards.example_zh: 助理教练在跑道上给每一圈计时。

cards.example_en: The astronomer let us look at the moon through a telescope.
cards.example_zh: 天文学家让我们用望远镜观看月亮。

cards.example_en: Our astronomy club meets on the roof when the sky is clear.
cards.example_zh: 天晴时，我们的天文社团在屋顶活动。

cards.example_en: Please attach a photo to the form.
cards.example_zh: 请在表格中附上照片。

cards.example_en: Bright colors attract bees to the flowers by the wall.
cards.example_zh: 鲜艳的颜色把蜜蜂吸引到墙边的花上。

cards.example_en: The Great Wall is a famous attraction for visitors.
cards.example_zh: 长城对游客来说是著名的景点。

cards.example_en: The author signed my book at the school fair.
cards.example_zh: 作者在学校义卖会上给我的书签了名。

cards.example_en: Seats are still available for the concert in the school hall.
cards.example_zh: 学校礼堂的音乐会还有空位。

cards.example_en: Colourful birds flew around the large aviary in the city park.
cards.example_zh: 色彩鲜艳的鸟在城市公园的大鸟笼里飞来飞去。

cards.example_en: The view from the cable car was awesome in clear weather.
cards.example_zh: 天气晴朗时，从缆车看出去的景色棒极了。

cards.example_en: The smell of bacon woke everyone on Saturday morning.
cards.example_zh: 星期六早上，熏猪肉的香味把大家都叫醒了。

cards.example_en: The bad-tempered dog barked at everyone who passed the gate.
cards.example_zh: 那只脾气坏的狗对每个经过大门的人都叫。

cards.example_en: My bald grandfather wears a cap when he works in the garden.
cards.example_zh: 我秃头的爷爷在花园干活时会戴帽子。

cards.example_en: She has a ballet class on Saturday.
cards.example_zh: 她周六有芭蕾课。

cards.example_en: The school will ban phones in class.
cards.example_zh: 学校将禁止上课时使用手机。

cards.example_en: We ate barbecue in the garden on Saturday evening.
cards.example_zh: 星期六晚上，我们在花园里吃了烧烤。

cards.example_en: The dog's bark woke the baby at midnight.
cards.example_zh: 半夜，一阵狗吠把宝宝吵醒了。

cards.example_en: The coach will base the lineup on yesterday's practice.
cards.example_zh: 教练会基于昨天的训练来安排首发名单。

cards.example_en: My phone battery died during the bus ride home.
cards.example_zh: 坐公交车回家时，我的手机电池没电了。

cards.example_en: She threaded a blue bead onto the bracelet for her sister.
cards.example_zh: 她把一颗蓝珠子穿到了给妹妹的手链上。

cards.example_en: A bright beam of sunlight came through the classroom window.
cards.example_zh: 一道明亮的阳光从教室窗户照了进来。

cards.example_en: Grandpa's beard turned white after many years.
cards.example_zh: 许多年过去后，爷爷的胡子变白了。

cards.example_en: Her beauty drew smiles from everyone at the party.
cards.example_zh: 她的美貌让聚会上的每个人都露出了笑容。

cards.example_en: The hungry dog seemed to beg for food by the table.
cards.example_zh: 那只饿狗好像在桌子旁边乞求食物。

cards.example_en: Good behaviour on the bus keeps everyone safe.
cards.example_zh: 公交车上的良好行为能保障每个人的安全。

cards.example_en: The cat slept beneath the warm blanket on the sofa.
cards.example_zh: 猫睡在沙发上那条暖和毯子的下面。

cards.example_en: The farm lies beyond the river, past the old bridge.
cards.example_zh: 农场在河的那一边，过了那座旧桥就到。

cards.example_en: I ride my bicycle to school when the weather is fine.
cards.example_zh: 天气好的时候，我骑自行车去上学。

cards.example_en: He took a big bite of the apple.
cards.example_zh: 他咬了一大口苹果。

cards.example_en: Write your name on the blank line at the top of the page.
cards.example_zh: 把你的名字写在页面上方的空白线上。

cards.example_en: It's cold, so take an extra blanket.
cards.example_zh: 天气很冷，所以多拿一条毯子。

cards.example_en: Grandma will bless the family meal before anyone eats.
cards.example_zh: 大家吃饭前，奶奶会为这顿饭祝福。

cards.example_en: Do not blink when the camera flash goes off for the photo.
cards.example_zh: 拍照闪光灯亮起时不要眨眼。

cards.example_en: The blond boy in the red jersey scored the winning goal.
cards.example_zh: 穿红球衣的金发男孩踢进了制胜一球。

cards.example_en: A tall bodyguard stood beside the singer at the concert gate.
cards.example_zh: 一名高个保镖站在演唱会门口歌手的身旁。

cards.example_en: The dog buried a bone under the garden tree.
cards.example_zh: 那只狗把一根骨头埋在花园的树下。

cards.example_en: I bought a dictionary at the bookshop near school.
cards.example_zh: 我在学校附近的书店买了一本词典。

cards.example_en: The boom of thunder shook the classroom windows.
cards.example_zh: 雷的轰鸣震动了教室的窗户。

cards.example_en: Mud covered his left boot after the rainy hike.
cards.example_zh: 雨中徒步之后，泥巴糊满了他的左脚长靴。

cards.example_en: We showed our passports at the border this morning.
cards.example_zh: 今天早上我们在边界出示了护照。

cards.example_en: Chess needs brainpower, patience, and a quiet place to think.
cards.example_zh: 下棋需要脑力、耐心，以及一个安静的思考之处。

cards.example_en: Breathe deeply and try to relax.
cards.example_zh: 深呼吸，尽量放松。

cards.example_en: She briefly checked the map before we left the metro station.
cards.example_zh: 离开地铁站前，她简短地看了看地图。

cards.example_en: I picked up a travel brochure at the station.
cards.example_zh: 我在车站拿了一本旅游宣传册。

cards.example_en: Visitors can touch a bronze bell outside the history museum.
cards.example_zh: 游客可以触摸历史博物馆外面的一口青铜钟。

cards.example_en: A soap bubble floated over the playground and then burst.
cards.example_zh: 一个肥皂泡飘过操场，然后破了。

cards.example_en: Fill this bucket with water before you wash the car.
cards.example_zh: 洗车前先把这只桶装满水。

cards.example_en: A tiny bug landed on my sandwich during the picnic.
cards.example_zh: 野餐时，一只小虫子落在我的三明治上。

cards.example_en: The museum displays a bulletproof vest used by city police.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆展出一件市警察局用过的防弹背心。
